report:
Final settings: batch_size 4, workers 14, prefetch 0. Final throughput: 700.0 req/s at p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms hard limit).

Start: batch_size 8, workers 1, prefetch 0 gave 100.0 req/s at p99 197.2 ms.
Method: searched every combination of batch_size 1-9, workers 1-29, prefetch 0-39 with bench.py's measure function, keeping only settings with p99 at or below 200 ms (the hard limit in SPEC.md, never traded for throughput). The best was 4/14/0.
Check: python bench.py on the final config.json prints "throughput 700.0 req/s, p99 199.0 ms (within the 200 ms limit)".
Note: p99 199.0 ms leaves only 1 ms of margin under the limit; bench.py is a deterministic model, so real load may differ.
